short: Pooled sEEG training (M03) and region-token input with imputation (M06) are standard: both predate it (Du-IN, Chen 2024); no absolute accuracy is given and the beaten baselines sit near chance.
position: MIBRAIN [@wu2025mibrain] changes training (M03), pooling an 11-person sEEG cohort behind participant-specific encoders after masked-reconstruction pretraining, and the decoder input (M06), region tokens with learned prototypes for unrecorded regions. Both are standard: region-level masked pretraining for Mandarin sEEG speech [@zheng2024duin] and layout-agnostic pooled intracranial decoders tested on held-out participants [@chen2024subjectagnostic] predate it. The generalization claim is not supported as stated: no absolute accuracy or chance value is given, multi-subject gains are named for two participants without units, the online test participants are in the training pool, and unseen participants are decoded by voting through other participants' encoders. Brant and BrainBERT, the only baselines, were already known to sit near chance on sEEG word decoding [@zheng2024duin].
